items.title: Clay Jenkins interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 18, 2016
items.q: Like I play a lot with this great drummer, actually originally from Rochester, Joe LaBarbera.

ctx.x: This was on people’s jazz dates?

Yeah. So different people have — you know I’ve had people come up and say, “you know I didn’t write a sharp nine on that chord.” I’m sorry. But some of it’s sort of serendipitous too, I must say. Sometimes I’ll try something just to see if it might stick. And it depends on the context. Like if I was called in out there in Los Angeles to record a solo over something else, a lot of times I’d just say, “what are you hearing?” Maybe, “why don’t you sing me something that you’re hearing.” Because I wanted to please.…
How do you revisit the blues?
